title: Strategic Account Director
description:

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows-including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence-we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Role Summary

 

Location: London

Hybrid

Full-Time

 

The Strategic Account Director is a new-business, quota-carrying hunter responsible for landing the largest, most complex enterprise logos in the market. You own the full pursuit - from target identification and outbound generation through multi-threaded, committee-driven sales cycles to signed, revenue-producing contracts. Your prospects run cross-border volume at scale, they are today served by incumbent banks or specialist fintechs, and displacing that incumbent is the job.

This is a role for someone who is energized by the chase: building conviction where none exists, getting into the CFO's and Treasurer's office cold, orchestrating a pursuit team through a long and technical evaluation, and closing seven-figure relationships. You set the bar for how strategic new business gets won at Payoneer.

title: Staff+ Software Engineer
description:
About Plasma
Plasma is building the primary account for global money.
Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world.
Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy.
Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move.
Technological revolutions obey power laws. The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built.

The Team & Our Story

We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses.
We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means.

• Consumer owns the core Plasma One product experience - onboarding, activation, retention, rewards, tiers, trading, earn, and account management. The team is responsible for growing funded users, engagement, balances, spend, and long-term retention.

• Payments owns the financial infrastructure that powers Plasma - accounts, ledgers, funding, payouts, card issuing, reconciliation, payment orchestration, and currency/rail integrations. The team is responsible for the reliability, scalability, and economics of moving and storing money.

• Business owns the Plasma experience for companies - the operating account for businesses that work globally: onboarding, receiving, holding, and sending money across borders, corporate cards and spend management, and the roles and approvals that keep teams in control of company money. The team is responsible for taking the product from its first business customers to general availability, and for growing the businesses that run on Plasma .

The Role
We're looking for a staff+ engineer, backend-leaning but comfortable full-stack, to join one of Plasma 's engineering teams and take ownership of that team's hardest technical problems. Our stack is TypeScript across the board - Node.js on the backend and React + React Native for the frontend
You are expected to set technical direction for your team's most critical systems, while partnering with product and, where relevant, other teams at the points where your systems connect.

The Work

• Own the hardest technical problems inside your team end to end - the ones that need deep judgment, not just execution.

• Set technical direction for your team's core systems: architecture, data models, and standards that hold up as the team scales.

• Design for reliability first: idempotency, consistency, and graceful failure recovery in systems that move or store real money, or that the network depends on.

• Go deep on the backend, but stay full-stack, own the TypeScript service and the data model, and work through the client or API layer when the problem calls for it.

• Define how your team's systems handle the hard edge cases: partial failures, retries, timeouts, reversals, reconciliation gaps - whatever “correct under pressure” means for your team.

• Contribute, architect and improve the frontend systems and integrations wherever necessary

• Raise the technical bar within your team: code standards, testing strategy, monitoring, incident response, and how the team approaches ambiguous problems.

• Mentor other engineers and drive technical clarity on the hardest parts of your team's system.

The Bar

• A staff-level, hands-on engineer with a track record of owning production systems end to end, n

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Us

Rho is the modern banking platform built for startups. Open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books - all in one connected platform backed by real human support.

About the Role

Our team is looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our data products team and help build & scale Rho's commercial banking technology.

The Data team builds data products for internal stakeholders and customers directly, maintaining a strong data driven culture across the company. This means treating data, pipelines, and ML systems as products in their own right: owned, versioned, documented, and built for other teams to discover and consume, not just infrastructure that sits behind the scenes. A key part of this role is building horizontal data products: reusable, ML-powered systems like an internal OCR pipeline, a transaction coding suggestion engine, and RAG-based and agentic systems that leverage our data to automate and augment internal workflows, that serve multiple teams and use cases across the company.

Technologies we use for data: Python, Go, Snowflake, DBT, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Terraform, Prometheus, Google Cloud Services, Omni, Hex

The ideal candidate is a strong software and data engineer with good taste & judgement, someone who knows what good looks like, and subscribes to a “strong opinions, weakly held” mindset.

Responsibilities:

- Design, build, and own data products, reliable, scalable, well-documented pipelines and datasets that other teams can discover, trust, and build on directly

- Apply strong software engineering practices (clean code, testing, version control, CI/CD) to data products and ML systems, treating them with the same rigor as production software, while moving fast in AI-first world

- Build horizontal, ML-driven data products, such as our OCR pipeline for document processing, our transaction coding suggestion system, and RAG/agentic tools, designed to be reused across multiple teams rather than built for a single use case

- Define and uphold data product quality: implement quality checks, monitoring, alerts, and SLAs so consumers of a data product can rely on it the way they'd rely on any well-run internal API

- Partner directly with the stakeholders who consume your data products to understand their needs, gather feedback, and iterate, treating them as customers rather than downstream requesters

- Collaborate with business intelligence and analytics teams to turn business needs into data products that are easy to find, understand, and self-serve from

- Lead initiatives to grow Rho's catalog of data products and improve the platform that supports them, expanding what other teams can build on top of

Requirements:

- 5+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or DevOps

- Proficiency in workflow orchestrators such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect

- Experience with major data platforms including Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or in-house HDFS-based solutions

- Skilled at building data infrastructure using GCP, AWS, or comparable cloud providers

- Comfortable managing and deploying services on Kubernetes

- Practical experience with Terraform or Pulumi for automating infrastructure

- Advanced programming abilities in Python and Go are integral to this role, along with strong SQL skills (Java experience also considered)

- Proven experience building, owning, and iterating on data products or data pipelines based on consumer feedback, not just building infrastructure in isolation

- Experience designing systems for reuse across multiple teams

- Good communication skills and a team-oriented, collaborative approach, comfortable working directly with the people who consume what you build

Nice To Haves:

- Experience building a data platform or data product suite from the ground up

- Experience integrating or deploying ML models into production systems (e.g., classification, suggestion, or extraction models)

- Experience with RA

title: Senior Core Network Engineer (HLR/HSS & SDM)
description:
Ready to make travel easier for millions? Airalo is the world’s first and largest eSIM store, helping travellers stay connected seamlessly in over 200 countries and regions. We trust our teams to take ownership, put customers first, and do work that has a real impact every day. What’s in it for you? Airalo offers team members a range of perks, including remote work, generous PTO, wellness and learning allowances, and, of course, our annual Airalo Away retreat. Learn more about our benefits here;

Hi, I’m Peter, VP of Networks at Airalo !

Our team ensures customers have instant, smooth connectivity from the moment they purchase their plan to the moment they arrive at their destination. We go beyond standard mobile service, building innovative solutions that enhance the traveller experience. We’re looking for curious engineers who want to design the future of global networks. Think outside the box, reverse-engineer solutions from ambitious product ideas, and help pave the way for Airalo ’s leadership as a global connectivity partner.

Airalo ’s fully remote Networks team is growing. You’ll work on the systems and infrastructure that keep over 20 million travellers connected reliably and securely at global scale. Solve complex technical challenges, optimize processes, and experiment with better ways to keep the world connected.

As our Senior HLR/HSS Specialist, you are the guardian of our subscriber data and the architect of our roaming efficiency. You won't just manage databases; you will own the life-cycle of HSS/HLR templates that allow our MVNO to scale globally. Your expertise in Profile & Template Engineering is critical to our success in maximising COGS and margin through sophisticated Steering of Roaming (SoR) and Sponsor Roaming integrations.
Your main responsibilities will be:

• Design and maintain HLR/HSS subscriber templates, ensuring precise configuration of roaming profiles, APN/PDN contexts, and Camel/Diameter triggers.

• Collaborate with roaming partners to implement and refine SoR logic within the HLR/HSS, ensuring subscribers attach to preferred networks based on cost and quality.

• Lead the technical deployment of Full MVNO profiles, managing specific QoS profiles and addressing (GTs, APNs) required for independent network operations.

• Act as the primary technical point of contact for our System Integrators, auditing HLR/HSS configurations, reviewing change requests, and ensuring alignment with the 2026 roadmap.

• Define and monitor critical HLR/HSS KPIs, including Location Update (LU) success rates and Diameter Transaction per Second (TPS) limits.

What you’ll need:

• Deep technical mastery of MAP (SS7) and Diameter (S6a/S13) protocols; additional experience with VoLTE Roaming (S8HR) or SMSoIP rollout is a significant advantage.

• Subscriber Mapping: Extensive experience with HLR, HSS, and UDM (User Data Management) in a multi-tenant or MVNO/E environment.

• Practical experience with Multi-IMSI applets and the logic required to manage roaming through Sponsor IMSIs.

• A solid understanding of GSMA IREG (IR series); familiarity with TADIG (TD series) and how HSS/HLR templates impact billing/settlement is preferred.

• A "detective" mindset for troubleshooting complex signalling failures using tools like Wireshark or roaming-specific platforms (e.g., Mobileum, Roamware, or SIGOS).

• Proven ability to manage technical projects with external System Integrators and roaming partners under tight deadlines.

Bonus Points

• Experience with 5G Unified Data Management (UDM) and Authentication Server Functions (AUSF).

• Knowledge of Cloud Native Network Functions (CNF) and containerised core deployments.

• Scripting skills (Python/Bash) for automating provisioning audits or log parsing.

If you are interested in this position, please apply via the link.

title: Partner Operations Manager
description:
ABOUT SLATE
At Slate , we’re building safe, reliable vehicles that people can afford, personalize and love-and doing it here in the USA as part of our commitment to reindustrialization. The spirit of DIY and customization runs throughout every element of a Slate , because people should have control over how their trucks look, feel, and represent them.
WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Slate is looking for an energetic, organized, and experienced Partner Operations Manager to join our growing team.
As a Partner Operations Manager, you will lead a team of Regional Partner Operations Specialists who work cross functionally to support our Vehicle Delivery Partners as they deliver vehicles to our customers on our behalf. This role will support the onboarding, performance management, and ongoing support of our Delivery Partners. This role is responsible for building a high-performing team of Partner Operational Specialists who support our Delivery Partners by maintaining strong, collaborative relationships that drive operational excellence, partner satisfaction, and customer gratification. This team will support our Delivery Partners who will transport, inspect, prepare, and deliver vehicles to our customers.
Reporting to the Head of Sales Planning and Fulfilment, you are customer-led in everything that you do. Your primary responsibility is to lead all aspects of our relationship with our Delivery Partners by working closely with Fulfillment, Logistics, Service, Accessories, and other internal teams while driving process and system improvement to meet and beat our customer’s expectations.
WHAT YOU GET TO DO

• Be the face of Slate to our Delivery Partners.

• Build and develop a high performing team of Regional Partner Operations Specialists.

• Act as the main point of contact (POC) between our Delivery Partners and Slate ’s internal cross functional teams, assisting with vehicle and delivery issues and driving the decision-making process to improve delivery effectiveness.

• Develop and monitor performance metrics of our Delivery Partners, proactively addressing issues to optimize operations and achieve cost effective solutions while maintaining high levels of service for our customers.

• Validate and approve our Delivery Partners’ monthly invoices against our internal records of work completed through thorough tracking and analytical review.

• Track monthly actual costs vs plan and make suggestions for improvements to our planning process and other processes to reduce costs.

• Implement and execute a vehicle and material inventory reporting and cycle counting program with our Delivery Partners intended to maintain extremely high inventory accuracy.

• Assist our Delivery Partners when there are needed repairs to vehicles prior to delivery to customers.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Operations, or equivalent is preferred. While a degree is preferred, we value hands-on experience and a proven track record of success as a suitable substitute and encourage candidates to apply who can demonstrate relevant and commensurate professional experience.

• 5+ years of experience in vehicle delivery and/or automotive distribution, preferably directly working with OEMs or Dealers.

• Proven track-record of overseeing a team of Regional Support Specialists.

• Proven track-record overseeing relationships with third party service providers with strong analytical and communication skills. You will be the face of Slate to our Delivery Partners.

• Strong problem solving capabilities, with attention to detail.

• Comfortable in start-up environments. You can roll up your sleeves to do the work and build, or recommend the tools needed to be successful as the company grows.

• A proactive, “one company” teammate with a continuous improvement approach, equally comfortable with warehousing practices, material management, business planning, and financial implications.

title: Software Engineer (Android)
description:
Collinson is the global, privately-owned company dedicated to helping the world to travel with ease and confidence. The group offers a unique blend of industry and sector specialists who together provide market-leading airport experiences, loyalty and customer engagement, and insurance solutions for over 400 million consumers.

Collinson is the operator of Priority Pass, the world’s original and leading airport experiences programme. Travellers can access a network of 1,500+ lounges and travel experiences, including dining, retail, sleep and spa, in over 650 airports in 148 countries, helping to elevate the journey into something special. We work with the world’s leading payment networks, over 1,400 banks, 90 airlines and 20 hotel groups worldwide.

We have been bringing innovation to the market since inception - from launching the first independent global VIP lounge access Programme, Priority Pass to being the first to sell direct travel insurance in the UK through Columbus Direct and creating the first loyalty agency of its kind in the travel sector with ICLP. Today we still invest heavily in innovation to ensure that we continue to deliver superior customer experiences.

Key clients include Mastercard, American Express, Cathay Pacific, British Airways, LATAM, Flying Blue, Accor, EasyJet, HSBC, Chase, HDFC.

Our mission is focused on doing good beyond profit, which for us means we seek out opportunities for our people to share in our success and that we give back to the communities and people within which we work.

Never short of ambition, the success of our business is delivered through the diverse and talented team of over 2,200 global colleagues.
We're growing our team in Poland and want to be upfront about how this role is structured. As we don't yet have a legal entity in Poland, we work with an Employer of Record (EOR) or umbrella company to onboard talent in the region. This means the role is offered on a fixed term basis via an international contractor agreement - and is fully remote.
Purpose of the job:
The Senior Android Developer at Collinson 's Travel Experience division will be at the forefront of
bringing our visionary roadmap to life, focusing on delivering globally appealing, customer centric
solutions. Acknowledging the importance of regional nuances, the chosen candidate will guarantee
that our digital offerings strike a chord at both the universal and localized levels. This role is pivotal in
architecting and developing Android applications that offer a smooth, user-friendly travel experience
for our global clientele.
Key Responsibilities:

• Design and build advanced applications for the Android platform.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.

• Maintain and enhance the existing codebase, with a strong focus on continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD).

• Identify, fix, and resolve bugs while continuously improving application performance.

• Ensure optimal performance, quality, and responsiveness of the application.

• Integrate and maintain third-party libraries and APIs to ensure seamless functionality.

• Continuously evaluate, adopt, and implement new technologies to improve development efficiency.

• Work closely with the design team to ensure UI/UX best practices and Material Design guidelines are followed.

• Identify and address security vulnerabilities to ensure a secure application environment.

• Stay up to date with the latest Android trends, architectures, and emerging technologies.

Knowledge, skills and experience required:

• 4 - 8 years of overall software development experience, with 4+ years in mobile application development.

• Hands-on experience building Android applications, with a strong understanding of Android app architecture, lifecycle, and best practices.

• Strong focus on user interaction, usability, and visual design, with an eye for detail.

• Solid knowledge of architectural design patterns such as MVVM, MVP, and Clean

title: Principal Radar Software Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service - spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack - from the lab to the field - we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview

Electromagnetic and Cyber Group (EM&C) is responsible for developing flexible and survivable advanced electronic warfare and secure communications equipment while providing the industry’s leading signals intelligence, electronic warfare, and cyber experts.  Metrea specializes in signal classification, direction finding, advanced geolocation techniques, and waveform development including waveforms for MANET and LPI/LPD applications. Metrea also develops special purpose radios for government customers and licenses DF and geolocation solutions to multiple OEMs.

Position Summary

RADLAB is looking for a Senior Radar Software Engineer to own the core software platform that powers our radar, communications, and RF sensing R&D. This is a hands-on systems programming role: you will own the shared C++ codebase, RADLAB CORE, that the rest of the team builds on. Your job is to make it fast, clean, reusable, and ready to deploy, starting from simulation workstations all the way to prototype hardware. You will work alongside domain engineers who own the signal processing algorithms, transceiver models, and environment simulations. Your job is to give them a platform where their code runs at peak performance, integrates cleanly, and can be tested and deployed with confidence. You will also work with our prototyping lead to ensure RADLAB CORE connects cleanly to RF hardware and test equipment, thereby owning the software side of that interface.

What You'll Do

• Own the RADLAB CORE repository: its architecture, module structure, build system, and dependency management. Design reusable, composable frameworks that let domain engineers plug in new algorithms without fighting the plumbing

• Profile and optimize computationally intensive signal processing and simulation pipelines. Identify bottlenecks, numerical stability issues, and optimization opportunities. Make the hot paths as fast as the hardware allows through cache-aware data layout, SIMD, concurrency, and GPU offload where appropriate

• Own the CI/CD pipeline, automated testing infrastructure, static analysis, and release process. Ensure the repo is always buildable, testable, and deployable

• Support domain engineers in translating their algorithms into correct, maintainable, performant C++ that integrates cleanly with the rest of RADLAB CORE

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Kotlin), Blipay
description:
Join the Tilt team
At Tilt , we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide , we're not just changing how people access financial products - we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.
About Blipay
Blipay is Tilt 's Brazilian business unit. In Brazil, credit is still decided by a score that summarizes someone's past and ignores their present. We do it differently - using Open Finance and real-time financial signals, we look at people's actual financial lives and say yes to people the traditional market writes off too quickly. Over 1 million customers. Salary advance, FGTS, consignado. Products that put money in people's hands when they need it.
The Opportunity: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
You'll work close to the product here - no intermediary layer between you and the problem. You're part of the conversation about what to build, you build it, and you watch it reach production. The loop is short and the stakes are real: salary advance, FGTS, and consignado move money in the lives of working people every month, so what you ship has direct consequences for someone. We're looking for a senior backend engineer who takes real ownership of their work, thinks carefully about how systems should behave, and wants to collaborate closely with product, credit, and compliance - not in isolation from them.
This role is remote. The team gathers at our Campinas office twice a year, and as part of Tilt you'll join two global offsites annually - past locations include Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City.
How You'll Make an Impact

• Build and scale the backend systems behind salary advance, FGTS, and consignado lending - with a clear eye on reliability and correctness

• Develop and refine the APIs that power an instant in-app experience, with the precision those transactions demand

• Work on the integrations that make payroll-linked and FGTS lending function - systems where uptime isn't optional

• Collaborate directly with product, credit, compliance, and analytics - your technical perspective shapes the work

• Contribute to code reviews, technical discussions, and team standards around quality, security, and operational excellence

• Share what you know with junior engineers and be the kind of teammate that makes the work better for everyone around you

Why You're a Great Fit

• 4+ years of backend engineering experience with demonstrated ownership of meaningful work - if you're close and the rest fits, let's talk

• Strong experience with Kotlin and/or Java

• Solid working knowledge of AWS, PostgreSQL, and ECS

• Experience building consumer-facing systems at real transaction volumes

• Fluent Portuguese and advanced English (C1) - part of the Tilt team operates outside Brazil and collaboration happens in English, written and spoken

• Comfortable using AI-powered development tools as a genuine productivity lever (we use Claude; similar experience transfers)

• Fintech, lending, payments, or regulated environment experience is a strong plus

Why Blipay
CLT employment with full benefits - health insurance, VR/VA meal allowances, and a home office stipend. Competitive compensation and Tilt equity. Remote-first with a team that spans 14 countries and 12 time zones. Direct access to leadership - good ideas travel fast here, and growth follows contribution, not tenure. And twice a year, the whole company gets together in person somewhere worth going.
Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.
What you'll get at Tilt

• Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursem

title: QA Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Transforming 50M+ daily events into real-time actionable dashboard insights

The Dashboards team is responsible for the systems and interfaces that define our partners' daily operations. We build the campaign management APIs, analytics engines, and high-throughput tools that allow advertisers and publishers to configure, monitor, and optimize their activity on our platform.

This is not about simple CRUD interfaces, it is about building high-performance data surfaces that drive massive business decisions. Using Go, Kafka, and Druid, we process and render real-time analytics across 50+ million daily events, ensuring accuracy and complex campaign performance reporting at scale. On the frontend, we tackle genuine engineering constraints: utilizing TypeScript and React, we have moved beyond standard library limitations to build highly optimized graph-rendering with Recharts capable of visualizing datasets that would overload conventional solutions.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

- QA with 3 years+ hands on automation experience, alongside a strong manual testing foundation. You design and execute structured and exploratory test cases, validate complex user journeys across frontend and backend, and perform regression testing before releases. You identify edge cases and risk areas early and document clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira.

- You contribute to UI and API test automation using tools like Playwright, Cypress, or Postman, identify critical regression flows worth automating, and maintain existing test suites. CI/CD integration experience is a plus.

- API and data testing is part of your toolkit. You test APIs and data-driven dashboard features, and have basic SQL knowledge for backend data validation. You understand what correct looks like at the data layer, not just the UI.

- Quality ownership from day one. You participate in refinement and sprint planning from a QA perspective, help define acceptance criteria and test strategies, and proactively flag quality risks before they reach release.

- Plus: Experience in SaaS, AdTech, or performance marketing environments.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

- Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

- Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

- Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

- Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other. 

- Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
About the Company:

Industrious is the largest premium workplace-as-a-service provider and home to the highest-rated workplaces in the industry. Everything we do comes down to creating great days for teams of all sizes and stages, including our own. We believe that what makes a great day at work is the people on your team and the problems you get to solve together. We’re looking for people who love thinking outside the box and thrive in a truly collaborative setting. As teammates, we encourage new ideas and toast every win. We’re excited about having a meaningful impact on people’s workplace experience.

Great days also start when everyone can be their authentic self at work. Diversity of backgrounds, thoughts, and ideas is critical to our success in delivering great workplace experiences, both for our members and for each other. Industrious is committed to creating an inclusive, respectful environment that embraces your individuality and quirkiness. You are valued for who YOU are. We celebrate our people as individuals who can accomplish great things when we work together as one team.

To learn more, visit www.industriousoffice.com/careers http://www.industriousoffice.com/careers.

SENIOR BACKEND ENGINEER JOB ADVERT

ABOUT THE ROLE

Industrious's Growth Engineering team owns every customer-facing surface we build: the member portal, the mobile app, the public site, for a member base growing alongside 100+ new locations this year. This Senior Backend Engineer seat is backend-leaning, genuinely full-stack, and comes with early access to the decisions that shape what gets built, not just how. You'll own production systems real members rely on every day, and design real AI agentic systems, agents, MCP servers, and the guardrails that keep them safe in production, not just use AI coding tools day to day.

You'll join a team of five to six, reporting to our Growth Engineering Manager. Code ships often here, you'll see the result of your work in the product within days, not quarters, at a company that's profitable, CBRE-backed, and still scaling fast.

WHAT MIGHT YOUR DAY LOOK LIKE

It's Wednesday, Hub Day, so you're in our Montreal office with the rest of the local team. Standup surfaces a reservation-access bug: a member's on-demand booking isn't unlocking their room. You trace it through a Kafka event that never fired, patch the service, and ship the fix before lunch.

In the afternoon you sit down with Product and Design to look at the next iteration of the credit-expansion feature, the one that lets members book new locations with their existing credits. You flag a data-modeling tradeoff nobody had considered, sketch two approaches, and the three of you land on one together, before a single ticket gets written.

Later, you pick up a small frontend fix on the member portal. It's not glamorous, but it's yours to own like everything else here.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Build and operate the backend services (Node.js, TypeScript, Kafka, MongoDB) powering the systems thousands of members use every day.

- Drive the expansion of our member credit system so members can book new locations, and lead the reservation-experience redesign in our newest member portal.

- Own reservation-based access: the system that gets a member into the exact room and location tied to their on-demand booking.

- Push our site's performance and reliability forward for our members as an ongoing discipline, not a side project.

- Ship across the stack, backend, frontend (React, Next.js), and occasionally mobile (React Native, Expo), so the team is never blocked by a single layer.

- Design and build AI agentic systems, agents, MCP servers, and the guardrails that keep them safe, as we integrate intelligent features directly into our core platforms.

- Help the team get sharper with AI-assisted engineering as we build that muscle together.

title: Hardware Engineer, Liquid Cooling
description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at  www.coreweave.com .

 

We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

 

What You'll Do

The Warsaw team is CoreWeave's EMEA hub for Hardware Compute, focusing primarily on CoreWeave Omni-our model for deploying and operating the CoreWeave Cloud Platform inside customer- and partner-owned data centres. We build, scale, and maintain the infrastructure behind high-density GPU systems, where thermal design, CDU integration, and cooling telemetry are first-class engineering challenges across diverse facility water loops and vendor configurations.

About the role

As a Hardware Engineer, Liquid Cooling, you will own liquid cooling infrastructure from the rack to the facility interface. In this hands-on role spanning engineering and operational support, you will automate the liquid cooling hardware lifecycle, develop hardware management services, and build monitoring systems for pumps, valves, and sensors. You will partner with facilities teams, server OEMs, and cooling vendors to qualify platforms, resolve RMA issues, and troubleshoot production thermal events down to root cause. Additionally, you will serve as the regional escalation point for thermal issues across EMEA and APAC, participate in an on-call rotation, and feed operational insights back into system automation and design improvements.

Who You Are

• 4+ years of professional experience in hardware, infrastructure, thermal, or platform engineering roles within data centre, cloud, or high-performance computing environments.

• Hands-on experience with in-rack CDUs (Coolant Distribution Units), liquid-to-air heat exchangers, or remote cooling units.

• Solid understanding of data centre thermal design principles, coolant types, thermal transfer mechanisms, and leak detection methods.

• In-depth knowledge of server hardware, components, and fleet management technologies.

• Proficiency in Python or Ansible, with hands-on experience programmatically interacting with hardware via Redfish, IPMI, or SSH (Redfish preferred).

• Demonstrated experience supporting production infrastructure, driving incident escalations through to root-cause resolution, and participating in on-call rotations.

• Excellent technical documentation and problem-solving skills, with fluency in written and spoken English.

Preferred:

• Experience bringing up new data centre regions or operating within customer/partner-owned facility infrastructure.

• Familiarity with rack-scale liquid-cooled platforms (e.g., NVIDIA GB200 / GB300) and CDU vendor management interfaces.

• Experience with BMC technologies, Kubernetes-based services, and observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana).

• Familiarity with facility-side systems including chilled water plants, CRAHs, and Building Management Systems (BMS).

Wondering if you're a good fit?

We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams-even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match.

• You love to: Solve problems at the intersection of hardware, software, and physical data centre facilities while automating thermal management workflows.

• You're curious about: Uncovering the root cause of complex thermal failures and integrating advanced liquid cooling technologies at scale.

• You're an expert in: Data centre thermal dynamics, hardware telemetry, and building reliable monitoring systems for liquid cooling infrastructure.

title: Senior Product Designer - New Ventures & Consumer UX
description:
At HelloFresh, the goal is to change the way people eat forever by delivering high-quality food across 18 countries and 3 continents. As a global food solutions group and the world's leading meal kit provider, the portfolio includes HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chefs Plate, Factor_, Youfoodz, Good Chop, and The Pets Table.

Engaging with HelloFresh in Warsaw means collaborating with HelloTech -a global technology division of over 1,000 people powering an end-to-end food ecosystem. From digital personalization and forecasting to supply chain optimization and food waste reduction, technology drives every step of this direct-to-consumer model. HelloTech operates in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, with each team holding full accountability for a specific domain. By collaborating with the Warsaw office, the service provider will leverage a modern tech stack and work with international teams to shape scalable, data-driven platforms that impact millions of global customers.

About the Role: What's in the Box

HelloFresh Group is building the next generation of consumer experiences across its portfolio-from discovery and personalization to shopping and subscription management. The Consumer UX team is at the heart of this work, designing end-to-end experiences that are simple, delightful, and grounded in real customer needs.

Services are required for Senior UX Designers across two squad contexts: one embedded in Good Chop , the premium American meat and seafood subscription brand, and one in the central Consumer UX team working across the broader HelloFresh Group portfolio. Both roles share the same craft bar, strategic expectations, and ways of working.

These are full-accountability roles inside a fast-paced environment. The provider will partner with Product and Engineering leads on a cross-functional squad, where UX serves as a strategic input to shape direction from the start. This role does not include people management responsibilities.

What You’ll Do: The Recipe

• Consumer Experience Design: Lead design from concept to shipped product, maintaining full accountability for the consumer experience across touchpoints while holding a high quality bar at every stage.

• Strategy and Roadmap Influence: Frame problem spaces before briefs are created. Bring evidence-backed consumer insights into squad planning to surface opportunities and inform what gets built.

• Craft and Execution: Maintain a high personal standard across UI, interaction design, motion, micro-interaction, and UX writing, using animation and motion as intentional strategic tools.

• AI-Native Workflow: Utilize AI across the entire design lifecycle-including insight synthesis, discovery, rapid prototyping, and design-to-code workflows-to increase execution speed and precision.

What You’ll Bring: The Ingredients

• Experience: 6+ years in product design, with a proven track record delivering high-quality consumer products end-to-end.

title: AI Data Readiness Lead
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Analytics is only as trustworthy as the definitions underneath it. As more reporting and decision-making moves to AI agents, the cost of ambiguous or conflicting metric definitions compounds, an agent applies the wrong rule confidently, at scale, and nobody catches it.

This role exists to prevent that. You will own what our numbers mean, make those definitions enforceable in the systems that serve them, and verify that both people and agents are using them.

This is a governance-first role with real technical depth. You will spend your time defining, implementing, and validating, building pipelines and developing agentic reporting are secondary.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

Own the metric registry. Establish canonical definitions for the metrics the business runs on. Where competing versions exist, convene the owners, document the disagreement, and drive to a decision. Publish changes with a clear statement of what moves and why.

Make definitions enforceable. Implement agreed definitions in the semantic layer and data catalog so they are applied by the system rather than described in a document. Retire superseded versions.

Reduce the surface area. Audit the reporting estate, retire assets with no audience, and establish ownership for what remains.

title: Financial Controller
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a financial operator to be the source of truth for Telos Media . You will own the books across four entities and several creative brands, and you will use what you find there to tell leadership where the money is going. The mandate is simple: make the books bulletproof, then tell us what they mean.

This is a dual role. You need to be comfortable wearing both hats, and the second one is what makes this a Controller rather than an accountant:

•
The accounting hat. You own the general ledger. You ensure compliance, accuracy, and a close that lands on time every month.

•
The analyst hat. You own the insight. You explain why a brand is profitable or bleeding, using data you personally verified.

What You'll Do

1. Financial reporting and control

•
GL ownership. Prepare the final general ledger and P&L across all entities for the Head of Finance to sign off. If it is in the books, you vouch for it.

•
The close. Run a disciplined monthly close so leadership receives the financial package (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) by the 10th.

•
Review and quality control. Review the Finance Officer's reconciliations and expense coding. You are the first line of defence against errors reaching leadership.

•
Balance sheet hygiene. A clean balance sheet with no unreconciled suspense accounts and no unexplained transactions.

•
Multi-entity and intercompany. Maintain intercompany balances across US, UK and merchandise entities, and keep the intercompany position clean and reconcilable.

2. FP&A and strategic insight

•
Cost allocation. Build and maintain the logic mapping shared overhead (finance, HR, leadership) to specific brands. The measure is an accurate net profit per brand.

•
Variance analysis. Lead the monthly forecast-versus-actual review. Do not report the difference; explain the driver behind it.

•
Bleed analysis. Deep dives into struggling or new ventures to identify exactly where cash is leaking.

•
Channel P&L. Maintain individual P&Ls for creative channels so unit economics are visible.

•
Cash forecasting. Support the rolling cash forecast across entities, including inventory and production commitments.

About You

•
Experience. 5 or more years in accounting and finance, with real exposure to multi-entity or multi-currency environments. Startup, outsourced-accounting or SME background is a strong fit; large-corporate-only experience often is not.

•
Technical stack. Deep Xero proficiency is non-negotiable, including chart-of-accounts design and multi-entity handling. Expert Google Sheets or Excel - pivot tables, lookups, and building a model from scratch rather than filling one in.

•
Certification. CPA, CMA or equivalent preferred, not required where operational depth is strong.

•
Investigative instinct. This is the differentiator and we screen hard for it. You do not just categorise transactions. If a margin moves 2%, you find out why before anyone asks. If a number looks wrong, you say so, including to people senior to you.

•
Communication. You can explain a financial result to a non-finance founder in plain language, and defend it when challenged.

What Makes This Role Worth Taking

• Full ownership of finance across four entities and several brands, with no layer between you and the Head of Finance.

• Direct exposure to the CEO and General Manager. Your analysis reaches them in the month you produce it, not a quarter later.

• Genuine breadth. Accounting, FP&A, multi-currency, inventory, production financing and international structuring in one role.

• A finance function being built rather than maintained. You will shape how it works.

As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations - and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works - join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

QRmaint is growing, and needs a salesperson who takes full ownership of the outcome - not just running conversations, but owning their own target, pipeline, and forecast end to end.

You'll run sales end-to-end on inbound leads: first contact, demo, close. But inbound isn't enough on its own - you'll actively build out your own pipeline with outbound (LinkedIn, cold calling, conference and partner contacts), because inbound alone won't hit target.

This is a role for someone who treats sales as a process to be managed - from discovery, through demos tailored to the customer's actual problems, to closing as the default outcome of a conversation, not a nice side effect.

This is a hybrid role - 2-3 times from office per week - Cracow or Warsaw.

 

ABOUT THE PRODUCT

 

QRmaint is a mobile-first CMMS (Computerised Maintenance Management System) that helps maintenance teams keep machines, equipment, and facilities running at peak performance. Built around QR codes, it gives technicians instant access to asset history, work orders, and maintenance schedules from their phone - scan a code and report a failure, log work, or pull a machine’s full history in seconds. The platform combines work order management, preventive maintenance, asset and spare-parts management, inspections, and downtime reporting on one central system, trusted across manufacturing, facility and real estate management, retail chains, schools, and field-service providers.

QRmaint recently joined SINGU - a leading provider of CAFM and facility-management software - as a new acquisition within the group. It continues as a distinct product in the SINGU portfolio, and this role is dedicated to it.

 

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 

- Own your number - your target, pipeline, and forecast are on you. You're accountable for the outcome, not just for showing up to calls.

description:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We're looking for a FinOps Engineer to help drive cost optimization and cloud financial governance across our AWS infrastructure and GCP footprint. You'll work cross-functionally with Engineering, Finance, and Product to find and ship savings, build the tooling necessary to maximize efficiency of every dollar spent in the cloud, and cultivate a culture of cost awareness across engineering teams.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not an analyst seat. You'll do the schlep work other teams don't have time for, digging into a bucket's access pattern, writing the Terraform or Lambda that ships the fix, working on a product feature chasing a number until it reconciles, and influencing product decisions when cost to reliability tradeoffs hit. Strong communication matters as much as technical depth, you'll regularly explain a savings case to an engineering team, a finance stakeholder, and a leadership audience in the same week.

What You'll Be Responsible For

In this role, you'll:

- Find and ship savings across AWS and GCP: Analyze billing, usage, and cost trends to identify opportunities, rightsizing, storage lifecycle policies, data transfer, and spot/auto-scaling. Take ideas from identification through to a realized dollar figure, not just a recommendation.

- Build and maintain cost attribution: Tagging policies, cost allocation, and chargeback/showback so engineering teams can see and own their own spend. This is foundational work other savings work depends on.

- Automate cost governance: Build automated cost reporting, anomaly detection, and alerting. Write the scripts and infrastructure-as-code (Python, Terraform, Lambda) that enforce cost policy rather than relying on manual review.

- Partner with engineering on architecture decisions: Bring cost into the room early, cost-efficiencies are cheaper to get right at design than to retrofit.

- Work with Finance on forecasting and reporting: Support budget tracking and financial KPIs; build dashboards engineering and finance can both read.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

- Have strong AWS expertise and working GCP knowledge, including pricing models, billing structures, and cost optimization mechanics.

- Have automation and scripting skills: Python, Terraform/ pulumi, Lambda, or Bash

- Are comfortable with cost/billing tooling: AWS Cost Explorer, Cost & Usage Reports, GCP Billing Reports, and BI/dashboarding (we use Hex).

- Have experience with, or are comfortable picking up, Linear and Notion as the system of record for tracking and documenting FinOps work.

- Experience with a dedicated cloud cost management platform (e.g. CloudZero, Vantage, or similar) is a plus, not required.

- Can analyze cost data and present it clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Have prior experience in a FinOps, cloud cost management, or cloud governance role.

- Are energized by doing the unglamorous, high-leverage work (the schlep) that unblocks other teams, and by working cross-functionally without positional authority.

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment-laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

Why this role exists
Most enterprises don't have a cloud and AI cost problem. They have a deployment problem. They may already know their GPU fleet is oversubscribed, their inference bill is compounding, or parts of their estate are running inefficiently. What they often lack is someone who can walk into a risk-averse engineering organization, identify the highest-leverage change, solve the technical problem deeply enough to earn credibility, and get the change into production.
That is this job. Not analysis - optimization deployment.
We are hiring Sr Deployment Strategists because the constraint is no longer simply finding inefficiency. It is landing the fix inside a real organization, with real approval gates, tribal knowledge, and engineers who may not have asked for a vendor's opinion. You will own that journey from the first workshop through production change and measurable business impact.
What you'll own
Scope

• Partner with executive sponsors - CTO, VP Infrastructure, VP Engineering, Head of AI Platform - to turn ambiguous mandates into concrete, time-boxed deployments with a defensible business case.

• Lead technical discovery and architecture review. Surface integration complexity, infrastructure constraints, change-control realities and the technical tradeoffs that determine whether an engagement is feasible.

• Establish technical credibility quickly with customer engineering teams, challenge assumptions constructively, and say no to work that will not land.

• Scope engagements around outcomes that can be deployed and verified, not analysis or recommendations that stop at a slide deck.

Deploy

• Sequence multi-phase cloud and AI optimization deployment roadmaps against the client's real readiness.

• Work alongside customer engineers on infrastructure and AI optimization. Own architecture decisions, technical problem solving, guardrails and policy layers, and integration into the client's pipelines and change process; customer engineers may own portions of deep implementation.

• Get changes through the client's existing workflows - ticketing, change templates, approval routing, security and compliance gates - rather than working around them.

• Diagnose and adjust when technical or organizational constraints emerge mid-flight, keeping sponsors and engineering teams aligned on the outcome.

Own the outcome

• Define adoption and impact metrics before deployment and hold yourself accountable to them.

• Own the executive narrative from kickoff through handoff, translating business outcomes into technical implementation and technical constraints back into business decisions.

• Design POC scope, success criteria and the graduation path into production, and own the case for expansion alongside the account team.

• Identify additional optimization opportunities as you learn the client's environment.

Make the organization better

• Turn field learnings into reusable playbooks so the next deployment starts further ahead.

• Push product gaps, integration friction and recurring client pain back into Helias with enough technical specificity to influence the roadmap.

• Operate collaboratively and independently: support the expansion of the team, remove obstacles without waiting for hand-holding, and consistently work toward the outcome.

What you'll need
Deep technical problem-solving and cloud infrastructure credibility - non-negotiable

• 10+ years of overall technical infrastructure, engineering, architecture or technical delivery experience, with meaningful public-cloud experience and deep expertise in at least one of AWS, Azure or GCP.

• A genuine software engineering foundation and meaningful responsibility for production systems. Strong candidates may have progressed from Software Engineer to Technical Lead / Staff / Principal Engineer and into broader cloud, platform, AI infrastruc

title: GTM Enablement Trainer, Claude Products

description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the GTM Enablement Trainer, Claude Products, you'll teach Anthropic's global field organization how to use our products, both to do their own work better and to position Claude credibly with customers. Anthropic ships quickly, and the surface area of what we build is growing faster than any individual seller can track. The job has two halves. The first is enabling our own people to be power users of Claude, so the field is the most sophisticated user of the product we sell. The second is enabling them to position it: to run a credible technical conversation with a customer, anticipate the hard questions, and hold their own with a technical buyer.

The best person in this role sees around corners. You won't wait for a launch to be announced before you start building enablement for it. You'll be embedded enough with Product and Applied AI to know what's coming, and opinionated enough to say which surfaces need real enablement investment and which don't. You'll need enough technical credibility to earn the respect of engineers and enough commercial fluency to earn the respect of sellers. You should also find more energy in enabling people to use what we build than in building it yourself.

Key responsibilities:

• Own product enablement for the global field organization, spanning new launches, existing capabilities, and the product roadmap ahead

• Build the programs that make Anthropic sellers genuinely expert users of Claude in their own daily work

• Create enablement that equips the field to position our products with technical and business buyers, including demo readiness, objection handling, and competitive framing

• Partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, and Applied AI to get early visibility into what is shipping and to shape how it reaches the field

• Anticipate which new product surfaces will require significant enablement investment, and make the case for that investment before launch

Experience bridging sales and technical audiences in a role such as solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical enablement, product marketing, or technical account management

Experience writing and presenting technical material for audiences with very different levels of technical depth

Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs, agentic frameworks, or developer tooling

Experience owning launch readiness for a technical product across a global field organization

•
Prior experience as a solutions engineer or sales engineer carrying a technical win

•
Experience building technical certification programs

•
A track record of shipping enablement content that the field actually uses

•
Experience partnering with Product or Product Marketing to prepare a field team ahead of launch, not after

title: Lead AI System Architect
description:
The AI System Architect leads the architecture of EIS's agentic AI platform - the design of multi-agent systems that automate insurance workflows end-to-end across Policy, Billing, and Claims domains. The role owns the patterns, frameworks, and standards for agent orchestration, MCP-based tool ecosystems, agent memory, planning, evaluation, and safety. RAG and conversational features are table stakes; the forward agenda is autonomous and semi-autonomous agents that act on behalf of users - quote intake, claims triage, underwriting and pricing intelligence, billing troubleshooting, and beyond - across our platform and technology stacks.
Key Responsibilities

• Own the architecture of EIS's agentic platform: agent orchestration, MCP-native tool ecosystems, agent memory (short-term, long-term, semantic), planning, and tool/function calling patterns reusable across product domains.

• Enable and provide support for domain teams for vertical insurance agents and the horizontal capabilities (RAG, retrieval, instructional flows) they compose from.

• Define and enforce levels of autonomy - assistive, semi-autonomous, autonomous - with explicit human-in-the-loop checkpoints, escalation paths, and reversibility for high-stakes actions in regulated workflows.

• Drive the MCP strategy: which capabilities EIS exposes as MCP servers to internal and partner agents, how our agents consume external MCP tools, and the tool registry, schemas, and versioning that keep this scalable.

• Maintain the multiple stack approach as a first-class capability: Typescript, and Java. Help teams to pick the right stack per agent and keep all aligned through shared configuration artefacts, prompt management, and evaluation tooling.

• Lead Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for agentic capabilities; partner with Platform, Security/InfoSec, and DevOps so agents are observable, testable, sandboxed, and compliant by default.

• Drive AI DevOps for agents: trace capture and replay, eval harnesses (task success, tool-use correctness, regression), prompt and model versioning, cost and latency budgets per agent, and progressive rollout strategies.

• Set safe-AI standards for agentic systems: prompt injection and tool-poisoning defenses, action allow-lists, blast-radius controls, PII handling, data residency, and bias mitigation. Treat agent safety as a first-class architectural concern.

• Translate insurance use cases into production agent designs with product strategists and domain architects; provide technical leadership and mentorship; communicate agentic trade-offs (autonomy, reliability, cost, safety) clearly to executives, customers, and engineers.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

• Proven track record designing and shipping agentic systems in production - not demos, not prototypes - with meaningful autonomy and multi-step tool use.

• Strong systems background: data-intensive, distributed, and latency-sensitive design in production environments.

• Deep, hands-on experience with agent patterns: orchestration, planning, ReAct-style and graph-based agents, agent memory, tool/function calling, MCP, structured outputs. Sharp instinct for when an agent is the right answer and when a deterministic workflow is. Tracks the frontier and translates what matters into the roadmap.

• Strong with the Java/Spring ecosystem.

• Strong with Typescript and Python for AI (LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent agent framework) - production experience required. Equally comfortable in both stacks.

• Hands-on with vector databases including embedding models, hybrid search, re-ranking, and retrieval evaluation.

• Experience with agent evaluation and observability: traces, replays, eval harnesses, guardrails, and cost/latency telemetry. Familiar with AI configuration-as-code.

• Experience shipping AI services on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) in regulated enterprise environments - security review, data residency, audit trails.

• Familiarity with insurance, financial service

Nebudeš zavřený na jednom místě. Tvoje práce bude hodně pestrá - od bleskového řešení oprav na lince až po zajištění toho, aby v celém skladovém zázemí všechno fungovalo a šlapalo jako hodinky. Pokud se nebojíš provozu, zvládneš komunikaci s lidmi a technologie jsou tvoje vášeň, jsi náš člověk!

Co tě u nás čeká?

- Sklad v top stavu: Budeš udržovat v chodu celý sklad a jeho systémy - od technického zařízení budovy a regálů až po moderní dopravníky a automatizované linky.

- Plánování i rychlé zásahy: Čeká tě běžná údržba podle plánu, ale i akční řešení nečekaných poruch a případných havárií přímo v provozu.

Jak si tě představujeme?

- Máš technickou hlavu a šikovné ruce: Máš základní technické znalosti a poradíš si s nejrůznějšími typy běžných oprav.

- Jsi týmový hráč: Rád spolupracuješ s ostatními a dokážeš se s kolegy i externími dodavateli lidsky a jasně domluvit.

- Zkušenosti jsou velké plus: Pokud už víš, jak fungují automatizační linky, jak je udržovat, opravovat a hledat v nich chyby, máš u nás obrovskou výhodu (ale pokud ne, rádi tě všechno naučíme).

title: Principal HPC Network Engineer (remote in the US)
description:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior HPC Networking Engineer to design, deploy, manage, and troubleshoot high-performance networking environments. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in InfiniBand technologies, strong general networking knowledge, and hands-on experience with Fortinet solutions. You will play a critical role in ensuring the performance, reliability, and scalability of HPC infrastructure.
Key Responsibilities:

• Design, deploy, and maintain high-performance network infrastructures for HPC environments, with a strong focus on InfiniBand fabrics.

• Troubleshoot complex network issues across InfiniBand and Ethernet environments, ensuring minimal downtime and optimal performance.

• Manage and optimize InfiniBand components, including switches, HCAs, subnet managers, and fabric configurations.

• Perform performance tuning, monitoring, and capacity planning for HPC networking systems.

• Implement and maintain network security using Fortinet solutions (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer).

• Diagnose and resolve issues related to routing, switching, latency, and throughput across hybrid network environments.

• Collaborate with compute, storage, and platform teams to support HPC workloads and cluster operations.

• Develop and maintain documentation for network architecture, configurations, and operational procedures.

• Participate in on-call rotations and provide escalation support for critical incidents.

• Lead or contribute to network upgrades, migrations, and new deployments.

Required:

• 5+ years of experience in network engineering, with a focus on HPC or data center environments.

• Strong hands-on experience with InfiniBand technologies (e.g., Mellanox/NVIDIA).

• Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), VLANs, QoS, and network design.

• Proven experience deploying and troubleshooting Fortinet solutions (FortiGate, FortiManager, VPNs, firewall policies).

• Experience with network performance analysis and troubleshooting tools.

• Familiarity with Linux systems and scripting for automation (e.g., Bash, Python).

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred:

• Experience with large-scale HPC clusters or AI/ML infrastructure.

• Knowledge of RDMA, MPI, and low-latency networking concepts.

• Certifications such as FCSS/FCNSP (Fortinet), CCNP/CCIE, or equivalent.

• Experience with automation and Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform).

Soft Skills:

• Strong communication and collaboration skills.

• Ability to work independently and handle complex technical challenges.

• Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

You will be the pivotal, end-to-end owner driving the product lifecycle for our cutting-edge data center storage solutions. title: Builder
description:
About SafeLease

At SafeLease , we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change. We believe the industry's biggest inefficiencies aren't technical problems - they're structural ones. And we're building the team to tackle them.
SafeLease is a profitable insurance business that designs, underwrites, and distributes specialty coverage for commercial property owners and their tenants. Most insurance companies either distribute products or bear the risk - we do both. We back our policies with our own capital, which means we control the full stack: product design, tech, and the speed at which we move. That end-to-end ownership lets us offer customers real flexibility, saving time and money for more than 4,000 properties insured for billions in value nationwide.
We're a team of 85, growing over 100% annually, and we've done it without sacrificing profitability or culture. Here, you'll get high discretion and a wide aperture of problems to solve. We embrace the newest technologies, move fast together, and operate with the intensity of a small company where every person's work is visible. If you're looking for a place to sharpen your craft alongside people who take their work seriously, you'll fit right in.
Why "Builder"?
The best people on our team start with a business problem, figure out what should exist to solve it, and then build it, often end-to-end. They talk to stakeholders, sketch out solutions, make product and design decisions, write the code, and ship it. They use AI tools not as a novelty but as a core part of how they work. The line between "product thinking" and "engineering" isn't one they spend much time drawing.
We call this role Builder because that's what it actually is. You'll work in small pods with a GM who sets direction, but how you get there and what you build along the way is largely up to you.
If you're looking for a well-defined backlog and a narrow lane, this probably isn't the right fit. If you want the autonomy to solve real problems and the context to understand why they matter, keep reading.
About the Role
To drive our mission forward, this role will:

• Start with the problem, not the ticket. Understand the business context behind what you're building. Know why it matters to customers, to the business, and to the team.

• Own outcomes, not just output. Take features from idea to production. That means participating in product and design decisions, not waiting for a spec to land in your lap.

• Build across the full stack. Write clean, maintainable code across frontend, backend, and infrastructure with a focus on reliability, performance, and simplicity.

• Use AI as a force multiplier. Leverage AI-powered tools to move faster, explore solutions more broadly, and spend your time on the problems that actually require human judgment.

• Improve the system, not just your code. Identify opportunities to make the platform better, the team faster, and the product sharper. Bring ideas, not just implementations.

• Collaborate with high context. Work closely with your pod, leadership, and cross-functional partners. Share what you know, ask what you don't.

About You
You're a problem solver who happens to write code, not the other way around. You care about what gets built as much as how it gets built. You're comfortable with ambiguity, energized by ownership, and sharp enough to develop a working understanding of the business you're building for.
Your experience:

• 2-5+ years of experience in full-stack software development with a track record of shipping real-world applications

• Background in CS/EE, a coding bootcamp, or equivalent hands-on experience building production systems

• Proficiency across Frontend (TypeScript, JavaScript, React), Backend (Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs), and Infrastructure (relational databases, Git, AWS)

• Demonstrated fluency with AI-powered development tools (Cursor, Claude, Copilot, etc.) - not just awareness, but active use in your workflow
